clips.title: The story
paras: Lady Anacondra is one of the Fanglords leading the Druids of the Fang within the Wailing Caverns. Once one of the night elf druids who followed Naralex in his ambitious effort to heal the Barrens, she was lost when her master's Emerald Dream communion turned into a nightmare. Her mind broke, twisting her devotion into a drive to remake the land to match that twisted dream.

Before adopting her serpentine title, Lady Anacondra was one of Naralex's druids. When the elder druid Naralex conceived of tapping into the subterranean springs of the Barrens through the Emerald Dream, she followed him into the caverns. Her loyalty, however, proved her undoing. As Naralex's mind was seized by dark visions, the nightmare seeped out from the dreaming realm and contaminated his disciples, shattering her sanity and reshaping her reverie into a cold, reptilian obsession.
